evidence.claim: ~60% global harmonic-specific reducer market share (dominant in harmonic segment); harmonic reducers are standard in upper-body joints (shoulders, elbows, wrists) across Tesla Optimus, Figure 01/02, Apptronik Apollo; FY2026 humanoid orders ~¥2.5B (+from ¥1.3B in Q2 alone); management guided 'could double or triple in FY3/27' from North American clients; stock +8.2% on FY2026 earnings day
evidence.source: Harmonic Drive Systems FY2026 consolidated results (BigGo Finance / JPX TDNet); Investing.com FY2026 humanoid orders; Harmonic Drive investor materials

evidence.claim: VERIFIED: Unitree G1 (world #1 humanoid OEM by units, ~5,500 shipped 2025) does NOT use harmonic reducers — uses quasi-direct-drive (QDD) single-stage planetary gearboxes with hollow-shaft PMSM motors; current sensing alone replaces dedicated torque sensors; confirmed across multiple technical documentation sources
evidence.source: Unitree G1 QDD actuator documentation (Unitree/ArcsecondRobo); Unitree G1 EDU technical specifications (RoboStore); arXiv 2506.16356 comparison of QDD vs harmonic-drive robots

evidence.claim: VERIFIED: Suzhou Green Harmonic Drive Technology Co., Ltd. (listed STAR Market Aug 2020, not Leaderdrive) is Tesla Optimus's PRIMARY Chinese harmonic reducer supplier; targeting 60% of Optimus supply with 500,000 unit/year factory opening 2026; priced 30-40% below Harmonic Drive Japan; 14 reducers per Optimus robot
evidence.source: Optimusk.blog Tesla Optimus supplier chain; Suzhou Green Harmonic (Baidu Encyclopedia verified listing); Yicaiglobal.com three core supply chains of humanoid robots

evidence.claim: Manufacturing barrier verified: flexspline requires high-performance alloys (18Cr2Ni4WA, 35NCD16), sub-0.5mm tolerances through heat treatment that can exceed total tolerance budgets; fine particle peening to 470 MPa residual compressive stress and 0.5μm surface roughness is the step extending fatigue life from 3,000 to 10,000+ hours; Chinese Tier-1 producers at 70-85% of Japanese benchmark for torque-density and fatigue life; scrap rates not publicly disclosed but flexspline fracture is documented as Chinese producers' primary quality challenge
evidence.source: ScienceDirect fine particle peening study; De Gruyter thermal-mechanical coupling analysis; ZHY Gear manufacturing review; arXiv 2506.16356

evidence.claim: Financial trajectory: FY2025 gross margin 26.7% (cyclical trough from utilization compression + capacity build); FY2026 gross margin recovered to 30.4% despite operating profit collapse of 94.4% YoY (caused by operating expense inflation, not gross margin); FY2027 guidance: ¥68B revenue (+14.2%), ¥6.2B operating profit (+141.5%), ~9.1% operating margin; 3-year roadmap target ¥90B revenue / ¥15B operating profit
evidence.source: Harmonic Drive Systems FY2026 results (Quartr, TipRanks, Finbox); FY2027 guidance (TipRanks)

what_could_weaken_view: QDD architecture already won at world's largest humanoid OEM: Unitree G1 (world #1 by units, ~5,500 shipped 2025) confirmed using QDD planetary, zero harmonic reducers — if AgiBot, Figure AI, or a next-gen Tesla Optimus adopts QDD for primary joints, the TAM assumption (15-25 reducers per robot) collapses to 0-8 per robot

Suzhou Green Harmonic (Chinese competitor) targeting 60% of Tesla Optimus supply: if the 500K unit/year factory achieves spec yield in H2 2026, Harmonic Drive Japan loses the world's highest-volume humanoid program to a Chinese supplier at 30-40% lower ASP — this is the single most important bear case trigger

Chinese domestic substitution: Leaderdrive (688017.SH) and Zhejiang Laifual at ±15 arcsec precision, >10,000hr service life; full fatigue-life spec parity for humanoid-grade (moderate duty cycle) applications estimated by 2027-2028; price 40-60% below Japanese equivalents; Harmonic Drive Japan gross margin fell from >36% to 26.7% over two years before partial recovery

Valuation already re-rated: stock tripled 2022-2024 on humanoid expectations; FY2027 humanoid order doubling/tripling is priced into the current stock; any slippage in humanoid production ramp (units stay in tens of thousands not hundreds of thousands through 2027) causes de-rating before fundamentals catch up

Operating expense structure is the new risk: FY2026 showed that even with gross margin recovering (30.4%), operating profit can collapse 94% — if capacity expansion fixed costs remain elevated while humanoid ramp disappoints, the P&L amplifies downside
